acceptance: Q72-shape and DATE_TRUNC(DATE) comparisons return the same rows as DuckDB on sqlite3 in fork tests.
Shipped-query corpus diff and executed comparison listed; fork PR merged; adopted in a wheel PR.
description: Adversarial review M3: TPC-DS Q72 'd3.d_date > d1.d_date + 5' stays integer addition on SQLite so text compares greater than the integer (toy repro 9 rows vs 2); the fork date-integer rewrite is applied only for postgres and questdb targets (runner.py:580-583). DATE_TRUNC on a DATE compared with a DATE returns 0 on SQLite vs 1 on DuckDB (TRUNC_FORMATS writes timestamp text, sqlite.py:32-40), the same class as the day-offset bug. Fix both in the fork with executed sqlite3-vs-DuckDB tests and corpus diff over shipped queries; adoption via wheel PR. Also record which published SQLite results used these shapes.
